changes: Implemented host-neutral observability M1 surfaces: story_authority_resolve resolver, observability_snapshot adapter, CLI registry/policy/process fact wiring, and focused smoke coverage for worktree authority plus no production authority overclaim.
usage: After building or installing this package, run lattice story_authority_resolve --format=json to get authoritative story cwd/phase rows, and lattice observability_snapshot --format=json to get Authority Ladder, Story Board, Capability Matrix, Recovery, and Parallel projection inputs.
expectedOutcome: Users see machine-readable read-only JSON surfaces with schemaVersion fields, authoritativeCwd resolved from worktree authority, and productionDone/receiptVerified/authorityChanged kept false without any dashboard UI rewrite.
actualTranscript: Project-local CLI emitted lattice.story_authority_resolve.v1 for B-381e with authority=worktree and authoritativeCwd=.worktrees/B-381e; observability_snapshot emitted lattice.observability_snapshot.v1 with all five sections, productionDone=false, receiptVerified=false, authorityChanged=false, and localDone-productionDone gap=1.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual matched for the project-local built CLI. The only environment note is that the currently installed global lattice binary is older until this package version is installed or linked.
limitations: Global lattice on this machine still points at the previously installed package, so immediate manual use requires node packages/main/dist/cli.js or reinstall/link of this package; no UI/dashboard page was intentionally built in M1.
pitfalls: Claude Code CLI implementation workers produced the core files but integration workers stalled, so coordinator finished mechanical registry/policy wiring; config phase whitelist was required in addition to command-policy or active-story phase gate rejected the new commands.
